name: Single Scattering Approximation
definition: A simplification of the volume rendering integral assuming low albedo and/or density, such that the probability of light scattering more than once is small. Only single scattering is considered, and glow is ignored.
summary: The Single Scattering Approximation simplifies volume rendering by assuming low density, considering only light scattering once and ignoring glow, which makes it fast but inaccurate for dense media.
